meal.name: Seafood Pepper Soup
description: A Nigerian clear pepper soup with tilapia, prawns and periwinkles.
Toasted ehuru, uda, alligator pepper and a little uziza flavor the oil-free, unthickened broth.
reasons: Mixed seafood supplies contrasting pieces in the broth.
The ground spice blend gives pepper soup its aroma.
No palm oil or cocoyam thickener is used in this version.

ingredients.name: fresh tilapia, cleaned and cut into steaks

instructions: Check seafood and keep chilled. Chop onion and hot pepper; wash/slice uziza leaves. Toast ehuru in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant, cool briefly, shell and grind with uda, alligator pepper and uziza seeds.
Put tilapia, onion, hot pepper, salt and water in a pot. Allow 5 minutes to reach a gentle simmer; cook for 5 minutes without vigorous stirring.

Add prawns, periwinkles, crayfish and the ground spices. Simmer gently for about 10 minutes, extending until every seafood piece is cooked and reaches at least 63 C. Swirl the pot instead of breaking the fish with a spoon.
Add uziza leaves for a final 1-minute simmer. Adjust salt and water and serve hot; no separately chosen accompaniment is included in this record.
